hooks.text: 战斗消耗行动点，每次胜利后只能从少数选项中学习或强化一项技能
hooks.excerpt: Combat relies on your skills and AP (action points). After each victory, you'll have the option of learning or enhancing a single skill out of a select few.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 探索同时消耗饥饿资源，未及时进食会把惩罚带入战斗
hooks.excerpt: Exploration is likewise a struggle against hunger. Fail to nourish yourself, and you'll be met with penalties during combat.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 迷宫中的混沌会污染灵魂，腐化累积至上限便直接结束游戏
hooks.excerpt: Even the slightest misstep can soil your soul, and once corruption reaches its limit you'll be swallowed up by a game over.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
